businesses.business: commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company (kidney and cardiorenal drugs)

offering_description.value: Develops and commercializes prescription drugs for kidney and gastrointestinal conditions. Sells IBSRELA for irritable bowel syndrome with constipation and XPHOZAH for lowering phosphorus in dialysis patients, mainly to US wholesalers and specialty pharmacies. Licenses rights to partners for other regions.

primary_products.value: tenapanor-based prescription drug for IBS-C; tenapanor-based phosphate absorption inhibitor for dialysis patients

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical wholesalers, specialty pharmacies, dialysis organizations, licensing partners; B2C: patients with IBS-C and chronic kidney disease on dialysis, reached via prescribers and pharmacies

revenue_model.value: product sales: net sales of IBSRELA and XPHOZAH to wholesalers and pharmacies; licensing or royalties: license revenue, milestones and royalties from regional partners

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: develops patented drugs, uses contract manufacturers, sells to wholesalers and specialty pharmacies

geography_served.value: global: US commercial sales, partners license rights in Japan, China, Canada and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: tenapanor-based drugs for IBS-C and dialysis hyperphosphatemia, plus pipeline

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: major pharmaceutical wholesalers and specialty distributors; other: specialty pharmacies and dialysis organizations, own field sales force promotes to prescribers; partners / resellers: licensing partners commercialize in Japan, China and Canada

regulatory_exposure.value: high: prescription drugs requiring FDA approval, also Medicare/Medicaid reimbursement rules, including ESRD bundle policy

notes: Product list from memory; partner details and current pipeline may be slightly out of date.
